body:
A lightweight CrystalPvP optimization modpack for Minecraft 1.21.11

This pack includes only essential mods focused on performance, stability, and PvP quality-of-life improvements. No unnecessary features, no content mods, and no visual clutter.

Designed for CrystalPvP players who want the highest possible FPS, lower latency, faster chunk loading, and smoother combat performance while keeping the game as close to vanilla as possible.

Included Mods

AppleSkin
BadOptimizations
Cloth Config
Dynamic FPS
EntityCulling
Fabric API
FerriteCore
ImmediatelyFast
Krypton
Lithium
Marlow's Crystal Optimizer
Mod Menu
ModernFix
More Culling
Noisium
Placeholder API
Uku's Armor HUD
Ukulib
Very Many Players (VMP)
VulkanMod

Features

CrystalPvP focused
Maximum FPS optimization
Reduced memory usage
Faster networking and chunk loading
Improved entity and block rendering performance
Minimal and clean mod selection
No unnecessary mods included
